question: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. Entire in my life(A)/one of the best gift (B)/ I have received (C)/ is the car(D).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary grammatical error is found in segment **B** of the sentence: **'one of the best gift'**.
 
• According to English grammar rules, the phrase **'one of the'** is always followed by a **plural noun** because it refers to one individual member out of a larger group.
 
• Therefore, the singular noun **'gift'** must be replaced with its plural form, **'gifts'**, to make the sentence correct.
 
• Example: **'One of the best students'** or **'One of the most beautiful places'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **B** (Option 1).

 

**Correct Sentence:** *'In my **entire life**, **one of the best gifts** I have received is the car.'*

 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **A: 'Entire in my life'** – This phrase is also awkward; a more natural construction would be **'In my entire life'** or **'Throughout my life'**. However, the error in segment B regarding noun plurality is the definitive grammatical mistake identified in the options.
 
• **C: 'I have received'** – This part is grammatically correct, using the **Present Perfect tense** to describe an action occurring at an unspecified time in the past.
 
• **D: 'is the car'** – This part is correct. The verb **'is'** agrees with the singular subject **'one'** (from 'one of the...').
